findings.message: references 6 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: contains multiple layers of encoding (hex/base64/unicode escapes)
findings.remediation: Avoid multi-layer encoding; it hindles review and may indicate malicious intent.
findings.impact: Multi-layer encoding (hex/base64/unicode) significantly hinders security review.
findings.attack_vector: Chained decoding layers — attacker increases analysis cost and may hide malicious payloads.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
